summary.text: Te Brown, a Republican businesswoman, former teacher and real estate developer, lost the November 3, 2026 election for Florida's 24th Congressional District to Oliver Gilbert III.
She ran as a political outsider.

paragraphs.text: Brown says she grew up in Chicago and built a real estate development and small business career from a young age.

Her campaign website gives her name as Te Mayonna Brown and describes her as a businesswoman, educator and real estate developer who says she has worked on affordable housing and economic investment in neighborhoods.
She describes herself as a former teacher who supports school choice, and as a homeschooling mother.
Brown says she is not a career politician. She won the Republican nomination for the November 3, 2026 general election.
During the campaign, she emphasized school choice, affordable housing, lower costs and limited government.
She received 19.3% of the vote to Oliver Gilbert III's 80.7%, according to unofficial results reported by NBC News.
